name: When Life Begins
overview: Scripture reveals that life begins at the moment God breathes the breath of life into man, making him a living soul, as seen in Genesis 2:7 and Job 33:4. The intimate involvement of God in forming life is further emphasized in Psalms 139, where God is described as knowing and shaping the individual from the womb, even before physical perfection. Isaiah 49:1 affirms that God's calling and knowledge of a person extend from the womb, highlighting the divine purpose and value of life from its earliest stage. Additionally, Exodus 21:22 reflects the seriousness with which life in the womb is regarded, underscoring the sanctity and protection of unborn life.
